A ufw rule for a port. Rules take effect once ufw is enabled; allow SSH before enabling it.

```hcl
step "example" {
  ufw {
    action = "..."
    port = "..."
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | string | Yes | allow, deny, reject or limit. |
| `from` | string | No | Address or CIDR the rule applies to. Defaults to anywhere. |
| `on_remove` | string | No | "delete" (default) closes the port again when the rule is removed or replaced, "forget" leaves it open. |
| `port` | string | Yes | Port, optionally with a protocol: 22, 22/tcp or 6000:6007/tcp. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_ufw_rule.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether ufw has the rule. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_ufw_rule` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
